title: Plasmid Luciferase Assay
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters in the OT App interface as prompted.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol files
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More > Custom Labware > Add Labware and select your labware files with a .json extension to upload.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: In the OT App’s Protocol tab, upload the protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Set up the deck following the provided deck map for the 384‑well‑plate assay.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate your labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App calibration routine; consult the support articles for calibration tips.

steps.title: Execute the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the plasmid luciferase assay.
